sources.entry: TabType - Free, open-source AI autocomplete for every Mac app — on-device ghost-text suggestions powered by a local LLM (MLX); nothing leaves your Mac. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/nilava/TabType) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: TabType is a free, open-source, alpha-stage macOS app that shows on-device ghost-text word and phrase predictions in almost any app, using a local Qwen3 base model run through llama.cpp.
summary.what_it_does: It shows dimmed inline suggestions as you type, which you accept with Tab word by word or with a separate shortcut for the full suggestion. Suggestions come from a local base language model (Qwen3-4B on 16 GB+ Macs, Qwen3-1.7B on 8 GB, as GGUF on Metal via llama.cpp) using a 9-wide beam search over whole phrases, and a confidence gate hides weak guesses. It reads context from the text above the field via on-device OCR with an accessibility-tree fallback, and can optionally learn from the user's writing through an AES-GCM encrypted local index. Per-app and per-website settings control enablement, ghost size and insertion workarounds, and a text mirror covers apps where inline ghost text cannot be placed. The README also describes inline /macros, :emoji entries, local autocorrect, battery-aware modes, iCloud Drive sync with end-to-end encryption, and in-app updates verified by checksum and signature.
use_cases: autocomplete while writing email in any Mac app
getting suggestions in chat apps like Slack
word completion in terminal AI agent prompts
local LLM typing assistant for macOS
how_to_run: Alternatively, download TabType-x.y.z.dmg from GitHub Releases, drag to Applications, and approve it in Privacy & Security since the app is not notarized
notable: Ghost text drawn in the app's own font, size and colour, read via accessibility or measured from the screen
Listen-only keyboard tap; Tab is intercepted only while a suggestion is showing
Context read from the screen above the text field, with an accessibility-tree fallback
Optional learning from your writing via an encrypted local index
Per-app insertion workarounds and per-website settings
caveats: Early alpha with rough edges; the author asks for bug reports on specific apps
Requires Apple Silicon (M1 or later) and macOS 14+
Not notarized, so macOS Gatekeeper warns on first launch
First launch downloads a 1.1-2.5 GB model from Hugging Face
Building from source requires full Xcode
